1.label: night-watch
1.body:
Night Watch finding from a fixed-seed CPU vs. CPU run. These are estimates for this bot and seed range, not human play.

- Kind: lean
- Candidate: e813ae8a3fdb5efbda75caddc28805d407ae8802
- Baseline: 6b6caeff465be6175eb2fe62ae16b3c54ead2598
- Mode: showdown; bot: playTurn level 2 (both seats)
- Seeds: 0-999, 1000 deals x 2 = 2000 games
- Candidate counts: 1188 Cowboy, 812 Wizard, 0 draws; 1142 first-player wins, 858 second-player wins
- First-player share: 57.10% (95% CI 54.92-59.25%, n=2000 decisive)
- Cowboy share: 59.40% (95% CI 57.23-61.53%, n=2000 decisive)
- Target band: 45-55% (operator-configured, not an approved design target)
- Lean verdict: lean; shift verdict: steady (threshold 10 pp)
- Per-card data: not measured
- Independent reproduction (scripts/night-review.mjs check): reproduced all 2000 games for e813ae8a3fdb seeds 0-999

Reproduce:

    python3 apps/night-watch/backend/server.py evaluate --repo <checkout> --baseline 6b6caeff465be6175eb2fe62ae16b3c54ead2598 --candidate e813ae8a3fdb5efbda75caddc28805d407ae8802 --mode showdown --first-seed 0 --count 1000 --band-low 45 --band-high 55 --out receipt.json
    git -C <checkout> archive --format=tar e813ae8a3fdb5efbda75caddc28805d407ae8802 -- package.json src prototypes/showdown | tar -x -C <snapshot>
    node apps/night-watch/backend/showdown_sim.mjs <snapshot> 0 1000 out.json

Night Shift review (local CLI, by hand; Fable/Alex choose the card and number, nothing is merged):

    node scripts/night-review.mjs run --finding <night-watch report.json> --card <card> --field <attack|health|stars> --to <n>

Night Watch does not read, comment on or edit this issue after filing it.
